Name: Whack-a-Mole
Author: Home Deck
Description: Turn a page of keys into a whack-a-mole game. A random key lights up with a bouncy little critter; tap it to score. Reach 15 points and every key fires off a fireworks celebration, then it resets and keeps going. Pair it with a Stream Deck folder page and the built-in Parent Folder action to hand the deck to a kid without worrying about them wandering off into your other profiles.

Actions.Name: Mole Cell
Actions.Tooltip: One square of the game grid. Place it on every key of a folder page and the keys will take turns popping up a critter to tap. All Mole Cell keys on the same page/device act as one shared game.
